title: THE OLDEST MAN

cover.text: THE OLDEST MAN… AND THE FLOOD
cover.scene: old Methuselah beside a single oil lamp at night, a giant gold 969 behind him, the finished ark far away under storm clouds

voice.note: same voice as Q.01 SEVEN THINGS

kjv.Genesis 5:21: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:
kjv.Genesis 5:24: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.
kjv.Genesis 5:25: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:
kjv.Genesis 5:27: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.
kjv.Genesis 5:28: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:
kjv.Genesis 7:6: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.
kjv.Genesis 7:11: …the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.
kjv.1 Peter 3:20: …the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.
kjv.2 Peter 3:9: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

rules: gentle and family-safe: no drowning people, no bodies, no destruction close-ups
God is never shown as a person, only as light
always say 'if you add up the ages in Genesis 5' for dates, and 'some say' for the name meaning

beats.text: The oldest man who ever lived died the same year as the *flood*. Coincidence?
beats.tts: The oldest man who ever lived died the same year as the flood. | Coincidence?
beats.camera: night hill: old Methuselah beside a single oil lamp; the finished ark far behind under gathering storm clouds; slow push-in
sfx: deep hit on the hook title

beats.text: His name was *Methuselah*. He lived *969* years.
beats.tts: His name was Methuselah. | He lived 969 years.
beats.camera: close-up of his face lit by the lamp, beard swaying in the wind; a thin glowing life-ribbon stretches across the frame
sfx: soft shimmer as the life-ribbon draws

beats.text: His father, Enoch, "walked with God: and he was not; for God *took* him."
beats.tts: His father, Enoch, walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.
beats.camera: golden morning path beside a soft beam of light; young Methuselah watches from a doorway; Enoch walks into the light and is gone; his footprints simply stop

card.text: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God *took him*.

beats.text: If you add up the ages in Genesis 5, Methuselah's life overlapped with *Adam*… and with *Noah*.
beats.tts: If you add up the ages in Genesis 5, Methuselah's life overlapped with Adam… | and with Noah.
beats.camera: parchment timeline across the screen: ADAM 0–930, METHUSELAH 687–1656, NOAH 1056–flood 1656; character icons at the bar ends; overlaps glow gold
sfx: gold glow chime on each overlap

beats.camera: dark with warm light: younger Methuselah (dark beard) at his house door; the tracker appears

beats.text: Methuselah was *187* when his son Lamech was born.
beats.tts: Methuselah was 187 when his son Lamech was born.
beats.camera: Methuselah rocks baby Lamech; a big 3D gold 187 rises from the ground (dips first)

beats.text: Lamech was *182* when Noah was born.
beats.tts: Lamech was 182 when Noah was born.
beats.camera: strong dark-bearded Lamech holds baby Noah; a gold 182 rises

beats.text: Noah was *600* when the flood came.
beats.tts: Noah was 600 when the flood came.
beats.camera: old Noah (white beard, builder's tools) beside the finished ark; a gold 600 rises
sfx: deep wooden thock + rising tone 3 (the three tones build a chord)

beats.tts: One hundred eighty-seven… plus one hundred eighty-two… plus six hundred… equals nine hundred sixty-nine.
beats.camera: the three numbers fly together and slam into one huge 969 over Methuselah's lamp; gold dust burst; short shake
sfx: big warm boom with choir-like pad on 969
beats.tts_note: numbers spelled out in one English clip (digits/short clips made the multilingual voice switch to French); pauses inserted at word boundaries; captions still show digits

beats.camera: extreme close-up of the lamp: the flame flickers and dies on 'died', a curl of smoke; 0.6 s near silence; one giant slow-motion raindrop splashes on dry cracked ground

beats.text: Some say his name can mean "when he dies, it shall be *sent*."
beats.tts: Some say his name can mean: when he dies, it shall be sent.
beats.camera: the cold lamp and his cane leaning on a rock; gentle first rain; the distant ark under storm clouds

labels.text: SOME SAY: “WHEN HE DIES, IT SHALL BE SENT”

beats.text: But notice: the flood came the same year his long life ended. As if God was *waiting*… as long as He could.
beats.tts: But notice: the flood came the same year his long life ended. | As if God was waiting… as long as He could.
beats.camera: time-lapse: Noah builds the ark over the years; ribs rise; seasons change green-dry-green; crowds pass laughing and pointing; old Methuselah watches from his hill each year

beats.text: "The longsuffering of God *waited* in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing."
beats.tts: The longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing.
beats.camera: time-lapse continues with the floating card; then (S12, in the held pause) the sky cracks with light, rain in sheets, camera cranes up as water spreads, the ark lifts (no people in the water)

labels.text: GENESIS 7:11 · “…THE WINDOWS OF HEAVEN WERE OPENED.”

card.text: …the longsuffering of God *waited* in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing…

beats.text: And God is still waiting today. Not to punish you… but *for* you.
beats.tts: And God is still waiting today. | Not to punish you… but for you.
beats.camera: match cut: rain on the ark becomes rain on a modern low-poly city at night; one person alone under a streetlight; the rain slows and a soft warm light falls on them
sfx: warm pad as the light falls (music resolves to D major)
